name: agentic-skill-router
description: Route skill-shaped requests to disabled Agent Skills and manage installed Agent Skills.

interface.shortDescription: Route disabled Agent Skills and manage installed skills
interface.longDescription: Agentic Skill Router searches locally installed disabled Agent Skills as an auditable corpus. Use it for skill-shaped requests involving named tools, APIs, services, CLIs, platforms, file formats, datasets, or domain workflows when no enabled local/user Agent Skill clearly matches. It also audits installed skills, suggests unused or stale entries, and safely disables selected skills by renaming SKILL.md files so they can be restored later.
defaultPrompt: Route this request to a disabled skill
